newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kumagai says can achieve orders target for 1996/97.
newsitem.headline: Kumagai says can achieve orders target for 1996/97.

text.p: General contractor Kumagai Gumi Co Ltd said on Wednesday that it thinks it can achieve its target of 930 billion yen worth of orders in the business year to the end of next March.
A company spokesman said Kumagai was especially confident of achieving its goal of 70 billion yen worth of orders in foreign countries, which was included in the overall target figure for the year.
Kumagai said the orders it had won overseas so far this year included projects in Singapore totalling about 14.5 billion yen.
Kumagai is also part of an international consortium which has bid for a project to build Bangkok's first subway system.
An industry source said earlier that Thailand's Mass Rapid Transit Authority (MRTA) would likely sign a contract with the consortium by the end of this month.
